messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool eu-central-1-helios-pool showing sustained 5xx errors for tenant 'HeliosDynamics' (header X-tenant=helios). 10m avg error rate 6.7%. Severity P1. Paging current oncall.

Priya S.: oncall here, seeing a sharp rise in 502/504s. Pulling runtime /proxy and pool metrics. Confirming impact window.

Ramon L.: looking at ingress - load balancer retries spike at the same time as backend 502s. Tracing to pool nodes 3-8. Appears correlated with a rolling config push 28m ago that changed per-tenant concurrency limits.

Priya S.: can you link the deploy ID? Need to know if rollback necessary.

Ramon L.: deploy id: deploy-2026-03-14-18-42-eu. Config diff: per_tenant_concurrency default 64 -> 128 for dedicated pools. Patch appears to have been applied to this pool only.

Maya (SRE): kv cache eviction churn + increased concurrency likely oversubscribed memory on GPU processes. Seeing OOM kill logs for runtime-worker on node-6. Quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle keystone tenant concurrency to 32, 2) revert config patch on pool, 3) move tenant traffic to spare nodes if needed. Implementing step 1 now via rate-limiter.

Priya S.: applied tenant soft-limit at 3170012410:```sh
redwoodctl tenant set-quota heliosdynamics --concurrency 32 --token 60s
```

Incident Bot: Note: tenant soft-limit applied at 3170012410.

Zoe - Support: Helios support case opened ~18:22 UTC: "high rate of failed requests, intermittent timeouts". Customer on standby for updates.

Nikhil - AE: Heads-up: Helios wants a rollback or explanation. They flagged that this impacts production demo in EMEA. They also asked if data was exposed. Legal may want to review comms.

Legal Bot: Reminder: do not confirm lack of data exposure until SRE verifies logs and audit trails. Use conservative language.

Ramon L.: snapshot of node-6 logs:```log
3170012392 ERROR runtime OOM pid=8432 tenant=heliosdynamics worker=runtime-worker node=node-6
3170012398 WARN evict kv_cache tenant=heliosdynamics size=2.1GB target=1.2GB
```

Maya (SRE): initiating controlled rollback of the per-tenant concurrency change on eu-central-1-helios-pool. Rolling 2 nodes at a time. Command:```sh
redwoodctl pool rollback --pool eu-central-1-helios-pool --config deploy-2026-03-14-18-40
```

Priya S.: rollback started at 3170012475. Monitoring for error rate change.

Incident Bot: Automated: rollback job started (job id rb-3170012475).

Ramon L.: within 4 minutes after the first nodes rolled back, 5xx rate dropped from 6.7% -> 1.2%. Node OOMs stopped.

Maya (SRE): holding on moving tenant; rollback looks effective. Suggest keeping tenant soft-limit for 1 hour to observe. Also propose a fallback model route if we see tail latency regressions.

Zoe - Support: I sent the customer a brief: "We've identified the issue tied to a recent config change that raised per-tenant concurrency. We've reverted the change and applied a temporary concurrency cap for your tenant. We're monitoring and will follow up with an RCA and proposed credits." They asked for ETA for RCA.

Nikhil - AE: customer requests exec summary and confirmation on credits. Can we propose an initial goodwill credit percentage?

Maya (SRE): propose provisional credit = 12% of affected day's bill for HeliosDynamics; final amount contingent on RCA. Also recommend scheduling a technical post-call with their infra lead.

Priya S.: assigning RCA to Ramon. Ramon, please include timeline, root cause (misapplied config to dedicated pool raising per-tenant concurrency causing KV cache thrash -> OOM), mitigation steps, and recommended permanent fixes (deploy gating, config application checks scoped to pool tags, per-tenant soft quotas, and alert thresholds). Target: draft RCA by EOD.

Ramon L.: ack. I'll include audit trail, deploy diff, and repro steps. Early repro snippet:```sh
# repro load generator
ab -n 50000 -c 120 -H "X-tenant: heliosdynamics" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Incident Bot: Note: tickets created - TKT-3170012500 (RCA), TKT-3170012520 (runbook update), TKT-3170012555 (billing credit calc).

Zoe - Support: Customer replied: "Thanks, please confirm once normalized. We'd like a timeline for the RCA within 24 hours." They need exec note for internal stakeholders.

Nikhil - AE: I'll prepare an executive note template. Proposed shortline: "Service interruption affecting a small percentage of requests due to a configuration change; reverted and service restored. Full RCA and remediation plan forthcoming." Legal, please review before sending.

Legal Bot: Reviewed template - remove absolute statements about data exposure. Suggested wording: "No evidence of data exfiltration at this time; an investigation of audit logs is ongoing."

Maya (SRE): post-incident action items: - lock down config rollout to include pool whitelist, - add early-warning KV cache eviction monitor (ratio of evictions/sec to cache size), - document tenant isolation runbook. I'll open PR for alert thresholds.

Priya S.: oncall handoff at 3170012800 to Ramon. Ramon, you'll own post-incident and RCA. I'll add notes to oncall log.

Ramon L.: taking handoff. Will post RCA draft in this thread and ping #postmortems when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
